thread:
megan: quick idea - when Dedicated pools hit sustained saturation, instead of full failover can we route affected tenants into a tiny Hosted 'quarantine' affinity pool with relaxed SLOs?
aditya: yes, small burst pool with degraded qos. prefer probe-first sample then ramp.
megan: probe-first + affinity header so hosted runtime knows it's quarantine traffic.
samir: KV/cache mismatch is the big risk. options: emit migration marker or do prefix invalidation.
courtney: must add telemetry events `quarantine_start`/`quarantine_end` with reason codes and tag billing.
liz: ops verbs: `rictl tenant quarantine <id>` and `rictl tenant restore <id>`. add rollback steps.
aditya: i'll prototype token envelope (migrate_v1::<b64>) and probe config.
samir: i'll sketch KV marker behavior and cold-cache mitigation.
courtney: i'll draft telemetry + billing tag mapping.
liz: runbook + CLI stubs on my list.
megan: actionables: aditya+samir spec token+kv, courtney telemetry, liz runbook, megan to write short RFC. canary on internal tenants first.
